posts.description: Cashback on shopping at Shopee, Lazada, Agoda and more. Save and earn rewards in Thailand and SEA. | แพลตฟอร์มแคชแบ็ก ช้อปออนไลน์กับ Shopee Lazada Agoda ได้เงินคืน ประหยัด และสะสมรางวัลในไทยและ SEA

posts.name: AIDA by Autafy
posts.tagline: Self-hosted personal AI assistant
posts.description: AIDA by Autafy is a self-hosted personal AI agent that runs on your own server. Connect Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, get morning briefings, triage your inbox, calendars, create documents from chat, reminders, built-in RAG, persistent and episodic memory and use it on Telegram, WhatsApp, or Discord. Bring your own API keys. One-time license. Your data stays with you.

posts.name: VoicyAgent - Build voice agents by chat
posts.tagline: Describe your business, get a voice agent that answers calls
posts.description: Describe your business in a sentence, and VoicyAgent builds a voice agent that answers your calls - books appointments, answers from your own knowledge, and hands off to a person. Test it in the browser, then go live on your website or a real phone number. It never invents facts.

posts.name: WebW.AI
posts.tagline: The easiest AI website builder ever
posts.description: Describe your business. WebW.AI generates a real website you can preview, refine, and publish free on yourname.webw.ai — not a blank canvas. Published sites stay light and load fast — static pages, not a heavy builder bundle. Most design edits are free and do not use AI credits. Upgrade when you want your own domain, more pages, or more AI. Try it: https://webw.ai Examples: https://webw.ai/examples

posts.name: Responsr
posts.tagline: A noise cancellation platform for sales team.
posts.description: Responsr is an AI CRM that helps sales teams manage leads, conversations and follow-ups in one place. Assign leads, track deals, send campaigns and see what needs attention. AI helps your team understand each conversation and decide what to do next, so no lead or follow-up gets missed.

posts.name: UpForge
posts.tagline: The independent registry for verified startups
posts.description: UpForge is an independent startup registry and intelligence platform built to give emerging companies and founders a structured, lasting presence on the open web. We verify company and founder information, create permanent public records, and provide a unique UFRN for verified startups. Alongside the registry, UpForge publishes founder stories, startup research and ecosystem intelligence for founders, investors and analysts.

posts.name: Export Assistant by Evolvix AI
posts.tagline: Instant AI export guidance & quotations for SMEs
posts.description: Export Assistant gives small exporters instant answers, not raw data. Enter a product and destination country to get the likely HS code, compliance requirements, market context, and a landed cost estimate in seconds. It also generates a full, editable, professional quotation document ready to send to buyers. Most trade tools cost $50-1000+/month and hand you a database to interpret yourself. This is free in beta (5 lookups/day, no card) and built AI-native from the ground up.

posts.name: RWA: True Profit Analytics
posts.tagline: True Shopify profit after COGS, fees, and ads
posts.description: RWA: True Profit Analytics is a Shopify app for founders and ads managers who are tired of vanity ROAS. Set COGS and costs, import ad spend as CSV, then see contribution margin and true net (CM1 to CM2 to net) in a Founder P&L waterfall and an Ads view with POAS and campaign spend. Leak flags, Shopify Analytics annotations, and CSV export. Lift adds MCP so Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can query the dashboards. Base $12.49/mo, Lift $17.99/mo, 10-day trial.

posts.name: Bowl Club
posts.tagline: Run ramen night like a shop, not a scramble.
posts.description: Bowl Club is a printable kit for hosting ramen night at home. Nine A4 pages: a one-night plan, a shopping list with substitutions, a table menu, place cards, and a bowl card for the stove. Instant PDF. Not food. You shop locally. $19, or $9.49/month.

posts.name: BREATHmg
posts.tagline: A 60-day beginner breathwork program for restless minds
posts.description: BREATHmg is a 60-day beginner breathwork program built for restless attention. Five breathing gears help you shift your state through 17 guided audio modules, immersive sound, and a consistent 40 Hz binaural beat. Inside My BREATHmg, track your practice, save private Awareness Notes, explore interactive guides, and practice with a private Buddy Circle. Start free with Baseline 30, your tracker, and the complete Beginner’s Guide to Breathwork.

posts.name: GzaMe
posts.tagline: AI ecosystem for self-growth & remembering life progress
posts.description: GzaMe is an AI-powered ecosystem for comprehensive self-growth that remembers your journey and preserves your life progress. It brings your Life Map, smart planner, AI Devi, quests, progress tracking, and access to specialists into one place. GzaMe helps you understand yourself, turn goals into action, and build a living memory of your personal growth over time.

posts.name: HideLens studio
posts.tagline: The video studio with no cloud, and no faces left exposed
posts.description: Your footage never leaves your Mac. And nobody in it stays recognisable. HideLens blurs every face automatically — in a video, a photo, or a whole folder at once, and live on your webcam in Zoom, Meet and OBS. It's a full editor too: subtitles, silence cuts, 9:16 reframe, transitions. No server, no account, no upload, no telemetry. Cut the Wi-Fi and it all still works. €9.99 once — €1.99 for the first 100.

posts.name: ApplyStronger
posts.tagline: Find real jobs and strengthen every application
posts.description: ApplyStronger helps U.S. job seekers search current employer-sourced jobs, compare a resume with any job description, find missing evidence, tailor resumes and cover letters, track applications, and prepare to apply—all from one place.

posts.name: Agentsy.pro
posts.tagline: Drive growth by letting prospects experience your expertise.
posts.description: Agentsy.pro helps consultants and experts turn expertise into business opportunities. Instead of simply reading about what you do, prospects can experience your knowledge and methodology through their own questions, getting immediate value around their needs. As prospects engage and move forward, their questions reveal what matters to them and where opportunities may exist.

posts.name: MidasAria Free Tools
posts.tagline: Free Excel calculators for traders and resellers
posts.description: MidasAria Free Tools offers two practical Excel calculators: a trading risk and position size calculator, and a reseller profit and inventory calculator. Both are free to download, require no account or subscription, and include a quick-start PDF guide.Free practical Excel tools for traders and resellers.

posts.name: Ready365
posts.tagline: Plan spending before upcoming bills arrive
posts.description: Ready365 is a straightforward Android planning app for people who want to see what may be safe to spend before upcoming bills arrive. Record your balance, bills and expected income manually, then view Money Left, a 30-day Money Timeline and a Before You Buy forecast. No bank connection is required, so users keep control of the figures they enter. Independently developed in Ireland. One-time purchase; no subscription.

posts.name: 7 Screen Studio
posts.tagline: Record & Capture screen
posts.description: Screen Studio is a menu-bar screen recorder for macOS. Auto-zoom follows your cursor and clicks; backdrops, a bold cursor, keystroke overlay and webcam bubble render live at 60fps, so there is no post-production. It records system audio with no virtual driver, lets you draw on screen mid-recording, then trim in a multi-clip timeline and export MP4, MOV or GIF. Screenshots, markup, redaction and stitching are built in. Free, no account, no watermark. macOS 15+, notarized.

posts.name: DealPulse
posts.tagline: See where every sales conversation is leading.
posts.description: After every customer conversation, DealPulse analyses your sales call transcripts and tells you whether the deal is becoming stronger, weaker, or simply going nowhere. It shows which opportunities are worth pursuing, which need attention, and which are unlikely to close, so you can focus your time where it matters most.

posts.name: What's the Pulse?
posts.tagline: The world's searches, mapped and explained.
posts.description: We created a different version of a trending search data website. Our goal is to help people understand what people are searching for around the world - and why. We monitor trending search data across 48 countries multiple times a day, adding category, search intent (why), related source reporting, images and concise summaries of why people are searching for that topic. We hope to help keep people informed, understand trends globally, and connect the dots you may have missed.

posts.name: SUNAGO Matrix
posts.tagline: ERP for Consulting & Engineering Firms
posts.description: Project-driven ERP for consulting and engineering firms. Unify CRM, projects, time tracking, resourcing, and invoicing in one platform.

posts.name: Slashscore
posts.tagline: The developer graph
posts.description: There are millions of public signals across GitHub such as repositories, commits, contributions, languages, organizations, locations, we wanted to turn those signals into something you can explore rather than another static developer directory so we built Slashscore, the developer graph. You can explore developers and their public activity geographically, get a 0–100 score based on an open scoring formula and compare your profile with the broader developer ecosystem.

posts.name: Tracer
posts.tagline: Capture, pin, annotate and translate on your Mac
posts.description: Tracer handles the everyday things that happen on your screen, quickly and cleanly. I wanted a tool that feels as natural as breathing. One shortcut, and what comes up is whatever the moment calls for. The fewest steps, nothing buried under menus, and the result is already in front of you. Most screenshot tools hand you a file and stop there. This one keeps the shot in front of you and keeps it useful. Everything else grew out of that. $3.99, one time. No subscription.

posts.name: GrowZen
posts.tagline: All-in-one AI outreach platform for lead generation
posts.description: GrowZen AI combines lead generation, email verification, outreach automation, inbox management, and analytics in one platform. Find qualified prospects from multiple sources, verify emails, launch personalised campaigns, manage replies, and track results without stitching together multiple tools. Built for agencies, B2B teams, and growth operators who want a simpler, more scalable outreach workflow.
